reason: This is the only available action, and it directly follows the lane-born stars into the returning galaxy.
expectation: I expect the stars to pass among the returning galaxy's stars and become part of its changing stellar population, though their exact paths are uncertain.

effect: The stars pass through the returning galaxy without colliding like their parent gas clouds, completing the chapter's goal.
reaction: The contrast between the clouds and the widely separated stars was a satisfying connection to the opening.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the lane-born stars across the other galaxy brought their story back to the contrast between colliding gas and passing stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was only one available action, so the chapter offered little room for a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the stars passing without crushing together matched my expectation.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the only action directly addressed the chapter's goal.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in continuing to see how the shared galaxy develops, though this chapter alone offered little gameplay choice.
